# Generated by tools/build_military_gui.py; scope is always the player country.

auto_qol_military_navy_cap_add_500 = {
 potential = { from = { is_ai = no } }
 allow = { from = { is_ai = no } }
 effect = {
  custom_tooltip = "auto_qol_military_navy_cap_tt"
  hidden_effect = {
   from = {
    auto_qol_military_prepare = yes
    change_variable = { which = qol_custom_navy_cap value = 500 }
    auto_qol_reapply_navy_cap = yes
   }
  }
 }
}

auto_qol_military_navy_cap_sub_500 = {
 potential = { from = { is_ai = no } }
 allow = { from = { is_ai = no } }
 effect = {
  custom_tooltip = "auto_qol_military_navy_cap_tt"
  hidden_effect = {
   from = {
    auto_qol_military_prepare = yes
    subtract_variable = { which = qol_custom_navy_cap value = 500 }
    if = {
     limit = { check_variable = { which = qol_custom_navy_cap value < 0 } }
     set_variable = { which = qol_custom_navy_cap value = 0 }
    }
    auto_qol_reapply_navy_cap = yes
   }
  }
 }
}
